jobs.jobDescription:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage by unlocking the true potential of the contact center. Our platform combines the best of AI and human intelligence to help contact centers discover customer insights and behavioral best practices, automate conversations and inefficient processes, and empower every team member to work smarter and faster. Born from the prestigious Stanford AI lab, Cresta's co-founder and chairman is Sebastian Thrun, the genius behind Google X, Waymo, Udacity, and more. Our leadership also includes CEO, Ping Wu, the co-founder of Google Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platform, and co-founder, Tim Shi, an early member of Open AI.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of AI and ML experts, go-to-market leaders, and top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sequoia, and former AT&T CEO John Donovan. Our valued customers include brands like Intuit, Cox Communications, Hilton, and Carmax and we’ve been recognized by Forbes and Bain Consulting as one of the top private AI companies in the world.

Join us on this thrilling journey to revolutionize the workforce with AI. The future of work is here, and it's at Cresta.

About the Role:

The Program Director, Strategic Accounts is a senior customer leader responsible for driving end-to-end deployments and value realization across Cresta’s largest and most strategic enterprise customers (>$5M ARR).

In this role, you will serve as the executive sponsor and trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders, orchestrating complex, multi-stream AI transformation programs across global organizations. You will manage the work of a team of Implementation Managers, Conversation Design and Customer Engineering, ensuring flawless execution and measurable business impact.

This role demands a blend of strategic vision, executive communication, operational rigor, and a deep understanding of enterprise transformation in the AI era. You’ll partner closely with Sales and Executive Leadership to drive growth, adoption, and advocacy across Cresta’s most valuable customer relationships.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive Enterprise Transformation:
     Own the success of large-scale, multi-phase AI transformation programs for Cresta’s top enterprise customers, ensuring business outcomes are realized across multiple business units and geographies.
  • Executive Stakeholder Management:
     Serve as the senior point of contact for customer executives (C-suite and VP level), providing strategic direction, thought leadership, and proactive guidance on maximizing ROI from Cresta’s platform.
  • Program Leadership:
    Lead a matrixed team of Implementation Managers, Solution Architects, Conversation Design and Customer Engineering to deliver complex implementations on time and within scope — balancing speed, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
     Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to align strategic initiatives, forecast expansion opportunities, and drive long-term customer growth.
  • Operational Excellence:
     Standardize delivery practices, governance models, and success frameworks to scale efficiently across accounts while maintaining white-glove service.
  • Technical Product Knowledge
     Insight and understanding of the Cresta product and configuration methodology in order to help assess & determine the critical path for working teams to overcome roadblocks.
  • Internal Influence and Leadership:
     Represent the voice of the customer to Cresta’s Executive Team, influencing product direction, go-to-market strategy, and delivery innovation.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise customer delivery, professional services, or program management roles within SaaS, AI, or CX transformation domains.
  • Proven success leading large-scale software deployments for Fortune 500 customers with >$5M in ARR and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or mentoring implementation or delivery teams.
  • Deep expertise in executive engagement, enterprise governance, and change management for complex technology programs.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence — able to influence C-level audiences and synthesize complex technical and business topics with clarity.
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to connect technical outcomes to business value and ROI.
  • Adept at building trusted, long-term relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Product organizations.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and autonomy.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for executive engagements and key customer milestones.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with contact center technology, conversational AI, or analytics platforms strongly preferred.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base salary + Bonus + Equity.

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.jobDescription:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

About the Role

Gatik is looking for a detail-oriented, improvement-minded Program Manager, Operations Process to own and improve the workflows that power our autonomous trucking operations. In this role, you will lead process creation, process review, and workflow design, and maintain the templates, standards, and gates that keep quality consistent across every operational workstream. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Operational Excellence, you will partner closely with subject matter experts across Operations, Fleet Maintenance, Safety, Training, and Engineering to turn operational knowledge into clear, standardized, scalable processes. You will be instrumental in maintaining quality and consistency while driving lean practices and continuous improvement.

This role is remote in the USA, with travel to sites.

What You'll Do

  • Own processes end to end. Act as the accountable owner for assigned operational processes across workstreams, keeping them current, consistent, and aligned from start to finish.
  • Design and maintain workflows. Build, document, and maintain operational workflows, including process maps, SOPs, RACI charts, and handoffs between teams.
  • Set templates and standards. Create and maintain standard templates for processes, SOPs, work instructions, and change requests so documentation looks and works the same everywhere.
  • Run process gating. Run quality gates and approvals for new and changed processes so they meet quality, safety, and readiness standards before rollout.
  • Lead process creation. Partner with stakeholders to scope, design, and launch new processes as operations and markets grow.
  • Run process reviews. Hold regular reviews to audit existing processes, find gaps or drift, and drive updates.
  • Partner with subject matter experts. Work closely with SMEs to capture expertise, validate process design, and secure adoption by the teams doing the work.
  • Drive lean practices. Apply lean tools (value stream mapping, waste elimination, standard work, root cause analysis) to simplify workflows and improve quality and efficiency.
  • Manage process change. Own version control and change management for process updates, working with Training to make sure changes are communicated and trained before rollout.
  • Improve continuously. Gather feedback from the field and turn it into targeted process improvements.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in process engineering, operational excellence, quality, program management, or business process management.
  • Experience owning and maintaining processes across several teams or workstreams.
  • Experience designing workflows, writing SOPs, and building documentation templates.
  • Experience running process review or approval mechanisms.
  • Working knowledge of lean principles and tools.
  • Strong ability to work with subject matter experts and turn complex operational knowledge into clear, usable processes.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and documentation tools such as Lucidchart, Visio, Miro, or Confluence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, trucking, logistics, fleet maintenance, or other safety-critical operations.
  • Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt, or equivalent lean training.
  • Experience with quality management systems or frameworks such as ISO 9001.
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where processes were still being defined.
  • Familiarity with change management methodologies such as Prosci or ADKAR.
  • Experience with workflow tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, or Smartsheet.

More about Gatik

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the first and only company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik’s well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.

Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

Notable News

  • Tech Brew: Gatik AI exec unpacks the regulations that could shape the AV industry
  • Business Wire: Gatik Paves the Way for Safe Driverless Operations (‘Freight-Only’) at Scale with Industry-First Third-Party Safety Assessment Framework
  • Auto Futures: Autonomous Trucking Group Gatik Secures Investment From NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS
  • Automotive News: Gatik foresees hundreds of self-driving trucks on road soon, and that's just the beginning
  • Forbes: Isuzu And Gatik Go All In To Scale Up Driverless Freight Services
  • Bloomberg: Autonomous Vehicle Startup Takes Off by Picking Off Easier Routes
  • Reuters: Driverless vehicles on limited routes bump along despite US robotaxi scrutiny

Taking Care of Our Team

At Gatik, we connect people of extraordinary talent and experience to an opportunity to create a more resilient supply chain and contribute to our environment’s sustainability. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility.

We at Gatik strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that together we can do great things. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the role

As a Senior Program Manager, Application Security, you will lead the post-sale journey for a portfolio of large enterprise customers, turning their investment in Harness shift-left and runtime security products into measurable business outcomes. You will guide implementations, build adoption, and earn the trust of security and executive leaders along the way.

You are the primary point of contact for your customers and the link between customer, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex security rollouts and helping people succeed with technology, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Deliver customer outcomes

  • Drive measurable value for enterprise customers from the Harness runtime and shift-left security portfolio.
  • Own the end-to-end journey: onboarding and implementation, adoption, value realization, and renewal readiness.
  • Build and run customer success plans that connect product capabilities to each customer's business and security goals, and track progress against them.

Lead complex security programs

  • Manage multi-workstream implementations, including roadmap, milestones, scope, resourcing, and risk, across Harness and customer teams.
  • Lead the engagement rhythm: weekly status, clear communication, and proactive risk management. You own the next steps and keep them moving.
  • Keep project and delivery records clean and current across your portfolio.

Grow adoption and customer health

  • Watch for early signs of risk, such as slow adoption, stalled integrations, or sponsor changes, and act on them quickly.
  • Spot opportunities for deeper adoption and bring them to the account team.

Build executive and cross-team relationships

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with customer executives, including CISOs and security and engineering leaders.
  • Plan and lead quarterly executive business reviews that show ROI, risk reduction, and the road ahead.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support. Carry customer feedback to Product, and bring the right people together when an issue needs attention.

Stay close to the technology

  • Learn the products hands-on and run product demos and workshops, in plain language that works for both executives and practitioners.

What you bring

  • 7+ years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Program Management, or Professional Services in a SaaS environment, including experience with security products or programs.
  • A track record of leading large, multi-workstream security or software implementations from start to finish, with results you can point to.
  • Experience driving adoption and customer outcomes in complex, fast-moving technical environments.
  • Working knowledge of modern security practices, such as secure software development, CI/CD, runtime security and vulnerability management.
  • Comfort building relationships with both executives and hands-on technical teams, along with strong analytical and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with CRM, customer success, and project tools such as Salesforce, Gainsight, and Jira.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

You don't need all of these. If you meet most of the requirements above and are excited about the work, we'd like to hear from you.

  • A program management or security certification, such as PMP, CISSP, or CSSLP.
  • Familiarity with “Forward-Deployed-Engineer” (FDE) and “Echo” delivery motion.
  • Hands-on exposure to application or API security, DevSecOps, or cloud-native tooling.
  • Experience with customers in regulated industries, such as financial services or healthcare.
  • Experience running product demos or technical workshops.

What success looks like

  • Customers reach their agreed time-to-value milestones on schedule.
  • Product adoption and customer health scores improve across your portfolio.
  • Executive sponsors can clearly describe the security outcomes they have gained.
  • Accounts renew and grow with no surprises.
  • Projects, plans, and status updates are accurate and current.

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

About the Role

Appen's Strategic Project Management team is central to the company's growth strategy, partnering with leading AI companies, frontier model developers, and healthcare technology organizations to deliver the data that makes models work. As Strategic Project Lead, Healthcare, you will lead complex medical AI data programs from solution design through delivery, bridging customer objectives, clinical expertise, and Appen's global delivery capability. This is a hands-on role with visibility across both the customer relationship and the delivery model behind it.

Your Impact

You'll own the quality and direction of complex healthcare AI programs, translating customer objectives into medical data strategies. Your expertise will establish the standards for how data is designed, evaluated, and delivered.

Across Appen's global delivery organization, you'll turn those standards into repeatable approaches, methodologies, and capabilities that support future healthcare AI programs and customer opportunities.

Success in this role will create healthcare projects that meet customer and clinical standards, strong customer outcomes, and a growing healthcare data capability that Appen can apply across its portfolio.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in clinical practice, healthcare, medical research, or life sciences, with a track record of leading complex projects or multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear specifications.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment where priorities and AI capabilities evolve quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing clinicians, researchers, or other specialist professional communities.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data privacy, security, and responsible AI governance.
  • Experience developing or reviewing medical datasets, annotation guidelines, clinical taxonomies, or evaluation criteria.
  • Exposure to AI companies, frontier AI labs, or healthcare technology organizations.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About the Role

CertiK’s security consulting team helps blockchain projects and institutions secure their smart contracts, applications, and Web3 infrastructure. We are looking for a Project Manager to manage the delivery of security engagements and keep clients, security engineers, sales and internal teams aligned from kickoff through final report delivery.

In this role, you will oversee timelines, maintain project documentation, and serve as the primary point of contact for clients across multiple engagements. You will track progress, follow up on outstanding actions, and keep stakeholders informed to ensure engagements are delivered on time and to a high standard, while providing a smooth client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the full lifecycle of security engagements, including kickoff, timeline planning, milestone tracking, report delivery, and closure.
  • Coordinate with security engineers, sales and other internal teams to confirm project requirements and ensure smooth handoffs at each stage.
  • Identify and escalate project risks such as delays or scope changes, follow through to ensure timely resolution and help refine delivery processes over time.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients, providing status updates, confirming timelines and managing change requests.
  • Lead client meetings such as kickoff calls and report reviews, support security engineers in presenting findings and remediation recommendations, and coordinate follow-up assessments and retests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of project management experience, with at least 1 year in the blockchain industry.
  • Solid understanding of smart contracts, blockchain security, penetration testing and the ability to discuss technical issues with both security engineers and clients.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating work across multiple teams.
  • Experience in client-facing project roles, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a cybersecurity industrials, particularly in security consulting or assessment delivery.
  • Familiarity with the broader Web3 ecosystem, including major blockchains and DeFi protocols.
  • Experience working with institutional clients, including financial institutions and enterprises.
  • Proficiency in additional languages, such as Mandarin, Spanish, or Portuguese.

Compensation

Additional Information

The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $90,000 to $120,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

Quince is seeking a highly analytical, technical, and operationally minded Program Manager, Materials Planning to support material procurement and sourcing across our global manufacturing and supplier network. This role plays a critical part in ensuring alignment between sourcing strategies, production capabilities, and operational goals.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in supply chain concepts, a collaborative mindset, and a desire to grow into increasing levels of ownership and impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support material procurement and sourcing activities across Quince’s manufacturing and supply base
  • Partner with internal teams and external suppliers to align sourcing strategies with production capacity and operational priorities
  • Evaluate supplier performance across quality, reliability, and operational metrics; identify risks and improvement opportunities
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Planning, Merchandising, and Sourcing teams to support execution, decision-making, and performance visibility
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, supplier performance, and overall value creation
  • Support reporting and analytics to inform procurement decisions and operational performance

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Foundational understanding of supply chain concepts, including procurement, inventory management, sourcing, and manufacturing operations
  • Experience or comfort working with analytics and reporting tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable recommendations

YEAR ONE DELIVERABLES

  • Material In-Stock Rate > 95%: Ensure consistent material availability to support production and minimize disruptions
  • Weeks of Supply (WOS): Maintain optimal inventory levels by balancing availability with working capital efficiency
  • Lead Time Accuracy > 90%: Improve and stabilize supplier and material lead times to support planning accuracy and responsiveness
  • Forecast Accuracy > 80%: Partner with cross-functional teams to improve demand and material forecast accuracy

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

$137,000—$185,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees — our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

Twice a year, we bring our fully remote team of ~175 people together in an incredible destination. We go all out on these trips, and the team gets excited about them months in advance. Read more about them in our public handbook.

We’ve traveled together to Mexico City, Lisbon, Medellin, Vail, and Santa Barbara. Our next offsite will be in Seville, Spain, in March 2027. We care about every part of the trip: a great hotel, meals, activities people will actually enjoy, and a few surprises along the way.

We’re looking for someone to own these experiences from the early planning through the final day onsite. It takes creativity, operational skill, and great communication. You’ll research destinations, plan the schedule, manage the logistics, and communicate with the team throughout.

To the rest of the company, you’ll be the face of one of the most fun parts of working at Tremendous — the person who builds excitement, keeps everyone informed, and sets the tone for the trip.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the creative vision, planning, and execution of two company-wide offsites each year for approximately 175 people.

  • Research potential destinations, find great hotels, restaurants, activities, and entertainment.

  • Build a schedule with plenty of time for people to connect and enjoy the destination, alongside a small amount of company programming.

  • Sweat every detail of the attendee experience, from the first announcement and travel guidance through arrival, daily programming, and the trip home.

  • Manage complex logistics from start to finish, including accommodations, transportation, vendors, meals, accessibility, contingency planning, and onsite execution.

  • Manage a substantial event budget, knowing when spending more will meaningfully improve the trip and when it won’t.

  • Build excitement before each offsite and serve as the main point of contact for the team, sharing clear updates, answering questions, and making sure everyone knows what to expect.

  • Gather feedback after each offsite and use it to continuously improve the experience.

  • Plan and run smaller team offsites throughout the year, including two GTM offsites, an annual engineering offsite, and occasional gatherings for other teams.

  • Assist with other company events and occasional special projects, such as logistics for marketing events.

What we’re looking for

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and are great under pressure when things don’t go well.

  • You have the ability to quickly grasp business objectives and translate them into an experience.

  • You bring energy and creativity to developing team activities.

  • You proactively identify potential issues with scheduling, travel, and projects and seek solutions.

  • You can take feedback and incorporate it into future events without compromising on vision.

You have

  • 2+ years in internal event planning or a similar role that requires substantial planning.

  • Experience producing memorable, high-touch events.

  • You’re a clear, warm communicator who enjoys working with people across the company.

  • Exceptional attention to detail.

What's cool about the role

  • We take these trips seriously. You’ll have a meaningful budget, plenty of support, and broad ownership over an experience that touches everyone at the company.

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $110,000–$140,000.

  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Program Manager, Privacy Compliance & Data Governance

Why We Have This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Program Manager, Privacy Compliance & Data Governance to establish, scale, and orchestrate our enterprise Information Governance program. You’ll sit at the intersection of Legal, Security, Engineering and Product, bridging the gap between business strategy, legal compliance, data security, and engineering. Rather than acting as a traditional gatekeeper, you will build and manage our "Data Front Door" to directly address how teams discover data rights, request entitlements, and manage novel data use cases safely and efficiently.

How You’ll Find Success and Grow

In this role, you won't just manage compliance—you will shape how our organization safely innovates with data in an increasingly complex global landscape.

  • Lead Enterprise-Wide Change: Grow your capability as a transformational program leader. You will drive a company-wide "Privacy by Design" culture, mentoring cross-functional team members and establishing sustainable governance practices that scale with business growth.

  • Governance Framework & Tooling Strategy: Deep fluency in privacy and data governance, establishing enterprise frameworks, data catalogs, and business glossaries that scale across high-growth SaaS environments.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities to distill complex privacy, legal, and technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance for executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

  • Operational Enablement: Proven capability to design centralized intake and triage processes ("Data Front Door") that convert complex legal and security requirements and restrictions into frictionless, self-service internal workflows.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Ability to bridge legal and privacy compliance requirements (stemming from laws such as HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) with practical and understandable technical access controls, working seamlessly alongside Legal, Security, Engineering and Product teams.

  • Proactive Execution: Takes initiative to define the "how" in ambiguity, driving cross-functional alignment and resolving policy conflicts across teams.

  • Adaptive Curiosity: A drive to stay ahead of evolving privacy and data security laws, security architectures, and novel AI/ML data use cases to keep our governance framework compliant, modern, and flexible.

  • Elevate Executive & Strategic Influence: Scale your leadership presence by interfacing directly with leadership and executive stakeholders. You will hone your ability to turn complex legal requirements into business enablers and present risk metrics directly to executive-level audiences.

Things You’ll Do

  • Build the "Data Front Door": Design and manage a centralized intake and triage process for custom data access requests, novel data questions, and complex derivative work inquiries.
  • Curate the Data Marketplace: Establish a centralized Use Case Repository and Data Marketplace detailing pre-approved data uses, restrictions, and licensing parameters across distinct datasets.
  • Automate Metadata & Classification: Partner with engineering and security teams to implement automated data classification, lineage tracking, and metadata harvesting.
  • Translate Policy into Technical Controls: Collaborate with InfoSec to operationalize legal requirements into enforced technical access controls (RBAC/ABAC) and row/column-level security protocols.
  • Drive Governance Adoption: Measure program success through adoption KPIs, request turnaround times, and governance maturity metrics, delivering self-service documentation and onboarding across the org.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 8+ years of experience in privacy, data governance, data security, data operations, or information architecture within a high-growth technology, SaaS, or data-intensive organization.
  • Deep understanding of privacy and security frameworks and ability to communicate contractual rights into practical guidance for various teams.
  • Direct experience setting up, configuring, or administering an enterprise data governance framework including the use of catalog tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, DataGalaxy, Atlan).
  • Technical aptitude with cloud data ecosystems (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/GCP), SQL, and data security mechanisms (e.g. hashing, tokenization, anonymization etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to create business-friendly, self-service workflows that accelerate R&D and AI/ML initiatives while ensuring compliance with laws and contractual requirements and adherence to security frameworks.
  • Preferred certifications, examples include:
    • IAPP: CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, or CIPT
    • ISACA: CISM, CRISC, or CISA
    • Data Governance: IGP or CDMP

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Enablement Over Gatekeeping: We view governance as a business driver. Our goal is to make doing the right thing with data the easiest path for our various teams across the business.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: You will sit at the crossroads of Legal, Security, Engineering and Product teams, serving as the connective tissue that translates legal policies into automated technical realities.
  • Built for Scale: As Qualtrics expands its AI and data capabilities, you will build the foundational governance frameworks that ensure our growth remains safe, ethical, and fully compliant.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Team cohesion is deeply important to us - we have frequent office events and regular team activities
  • We take pride in our office design aimed at fostering creativity, from our mountain views to an open and collaborative workspace.
  • 30 paid days off - 15 Vacation Days + 5 Personal Days + 10 Holiday Closures (additional after a year) + 3 company shut down days the first week of January
  • On top of standard benefits package (medical employees and their families, dental, vision, life insurance, etc) we provide free lunches every work day, snacks, and drinks

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Roboflow is on a mission to give software the sense of sight.

Our platform makes it easier for developers and organizations to build, deploy, and manage computer vision applications. More than 1 million developers have used Roboflow, and our customers range from startups to some of the largest companies in the world.

As computer vision moves from experimentation into production, we're helping companies deploy visual AI into the physical world - across manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, retail, and countless other industries.

We're looking for a Head of Delivery to own and scale how we take our most complex customers from vision to production.

The Opportunity

Our customers come to Roboflow with ambitious problems: automating quality inspection, monitoring infrastructure, understanding physical environments, improving operational workflows, and building entirely new products powered by computer vision.

Getting those applications into production often requires much more than handing a customer software.

Our Delivery organization, including Implementation Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering, works alongside customers to turn those ideas into real, production-ready systems.

We're looking for a leader who can build this function for the next stage of Roboflow's growth.

You'll own the teams, operating model, and customer delivery strategy, while remaining deeply involved in the work yourself. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage delivery from a distance. We expect you to understand our customers' problems, get into the technical details with your team, join critical customer conversations, and help solve the hardest deployments.

You'll be both the architect of the organization and an active participant in the work.

What You'll Do

Lead and scale our Delivery organization. Own our Implementation Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering teams and continue building the organizational structure, roles, processes, and operating cadence required as Roboflow scales.

Get hands-on with our hardest deployments. Work directly with customers and your team on complex implementations. You'll be comfortable jumping into an architecture discussion, helping scope a deployment, troubleshooting an implementation, or joining an executive customer conversation when needed.

Build the playbook. Create repeatable frameworks for scoping, implementation, deployment, escalation, and handoff without forcing every customer into the same model.

Own the path from sale to production. Partner closely with Sales and Solutions Architects before contracts are signed to ensure we're setting customers and our own teams up for successful deployments.

Drive customer outcomes and success. Establish clear definitions of implementation success, time-to-value, deployment health, and customer outcomes, and build the systems needed to measure and improve them.

Make the organization more scalable. Identify where we should solve a problem through people, process, product, documentation, tooling, or automation. The goal isn't simply to add more Delivery headcount as customers grow.

Develop exceptional technical talent. Hire, coach, and develop Implementation Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers who combine technical depth with strong customer instincts and high ownership.

Create tight feedback loops with Product and Engineering. Delivery will see some of our customers' hardest technical problems firsthand. You'll ensure those learnings make their way back into our product and influence where we invest.

Partner across GTM. Work closely with Sales, Solutions Architects, Support, and Partnerships to create a seamless customer experience from initial discovery through production deployment and expansion.

Who You Are

  • You've built or led a customer-facing technical delivery, forward deployed engineering, implementation engineering, professional services, or similar organization in a technical software company.

  • You're deeply technical and comfortable working alongside engineers on complex customer problems.

  • You're a hands-on leader. Managing a team doesn't mean stepping away from the work.

  • You've personally worked with customers on complex implementations and understand what it takes to move from a promising proof of concept to a production system.

  • You know how to balance customer-specific needs with the need to build a scalable product and organization.

  • You're an excellent people leader who can attract, develop, and retain highly technical, high-agency talent.

  • You can operate comfortably across technical and business audiences — from engineers working through an architecture problem to executives discussing business outcomes.

  • You have strong judgment around prioritization and resource allocation, particularly when multiple important customers need support at the same time.

  • You thrive in environments where the playbook is still being written.

We'd Be Especially Excited If

  • You've built a Delivery or Forward Deployed Engineering function from an earlier stage.

  • You've worked in developer tools, infrastructure, AI/ML, data platforms, robotics, computer vision, or another deeply technical product environment.

  • You've supported deployments involving both software and the physical world.

  • You have experience working with enterprise customers on complex, multi-stakeholder deployments.

  • You've built systems that meaningfully improved time-to-value or made a services-heavy motion more repeatable and scalable.

  • You’ve owned the entire customer success process.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you've built a clear operating model across Implementation Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering, created stronger consistency in how we scope and execute customer deployments, and developed a team capable of supporting increasingly complex customers.

Our largest customers are getting to production faster and with greater predictability. Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery have clear feedback loops and ownership boundaries.

And as the organization has grown, you've remained close enough to the work that when an important customer hits a difficult technical problem, you're someone the team wants in the room.

Why Roboflow

Computer vision is moving from research and experimentation into the real world.

The companies that successfully deploy it won't just need great models. They'll need to integrate visual AI into existing systems, hardware, workflows, and physical environments.

Delivery sits directly at that intersection.

You'll have the opportunity to build the organization that helps some of the world's most ambitious companies turn computer vision from an idea into something running in production — while helping Roboflow learn how to make that process dramatically easier for every customer that follows.

You're operating at the intersection of people leadership, technical delivery, and enterprise account management, and you're judged on outcomes, not activity.

We want leaders who've done the implementation work themselves and now want to multiply that impact through a team: coach the engineers, clear the blockers and build the delivery muscle that lets Kong keep pace with enterprise demand for API and AI connectivity.

You'll work daily with Solutions Architects, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Product Engineering — scoping engagements correctly before they land on your team, and feeding what you learn in the field straight back into how Kong builds and sells.

This is a rare seat: AI connectivity is a land grab right now, and the person who builds this team's delivery model in the next 18 months owns a track record that doesn't come around twice.

Impact

Lead the team that turns Kong's platform into production reality for some of the world's largest enterprises — the ones deciding right now how AI gets governed, secured, and scaled across their business.

Growth

Build your leadership craft against the fastest-moving category in enterprise software: AI connectivity, cloud-native architecture, and distributed systems at Fortune 500 scale. Prove out this team's model and the case for more scope writes itself.

Join a Professional Services organization growing as fast as the AI adoption curve it's built to serve — market-leading credibility behind every conversation you walk into, and a direct hand in building the delivery model while it's still being written.

  • Manage and grow a team of Field Engineers and Engagement Managers — hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

  • Own delivery outcomes across your book of business: go-live dates, technical quality, and customer satisfaction. Report on them with the same rigor you'd demand from your team.

  • Staff the right Field Engineer and Engagement Manager to every engagement based on account complexity, technical scope, and team capacity.

  • Be the senior escalation point on at-risk or high-complexity engagements — drive resolution and direct the team's response personally.

  • Run your team's operating cadence: staffing reviews, at-risk reviews, 1:1s, and status reporting up to Professional Services leadership.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Architecture to scope new engagements accurately and take clean handoffs from pre-sale to delivery.

  • Set and enforce delivery standards across your team — reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that outlive any single engagement.

  • Feed what your team learns in the field back to Kong Product and Engineering — real customer signal shapes our roadmap.

  • Lead your team's work on the strategic initiatives that matter most right now: AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

What You'll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, professional services, or platform engineering, including 2+ years directly managing a technical, customer-facing team.

  • A track record of delivery leadership in API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms — deep enough that you can direct and evaluate your team's work, not just review it.

  • Experience managing staffing, capacity, and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent enterprise engagements.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure fluency — enough to unblock your team and hold your own with customer architects and executives.

  • Experience with major cloud providers: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Comfort directing and evaluating automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling built by your team.

  • Prior experience in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is a strong plus.

Preferred Attributes

  • A decisive leadership mindset — you make the staffing and prioritization call and drive it to resolution without needing to do the work yourself.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments where the right call today beats the perfect call next week.

  • A genuine passion for growing engineers and engagement managers into their next role — this job is measured in the careers you build, not just the accounts you save.

  • Excellent communication across technical and executive audiences, internal and customer-facing.

  • Highly organized, with strong prioritization and execution across a multi-account portfolio.

  • Real enthusiasm for AI, modern infrastructure, and cloud-native technology — this team is living the shift, not reading about it.

  • A strong sense of ownership for outcomes that aren't always fully in your control — that's the job.

  • Operate as the internal subject matter authority on global packaging program management. Leadership, design, legal, and supply chain turn to you for strategic counsel and guidance.

  • Contribute to process development, onboarding standards, and the craft development of the DPM function as it grows.

  • Build the frameworks other DPMs and future hires will use, this is as much about designing the operating system as running it.

Drive org-level prioritization

  • Design the global prioritization framework, the criteria, inputs, and escalation model that surface regional urgency, regulatory deadlines, creative capacity, and business impact, so that decision-makers can make faster, better-informed tradeoff calls.

  • Build the mechanisms (dashboards, briefing formats, escalation paths) that get the right tradeoffs in front of the right leaders before they become problems.

  • Influence roadmap and planning decisions across design, supply chain, and marketing by providing a clear, data-informed picture of capacity and risk.

PROGRAM EXECUTION & REGIONAL OWNERSHIP

Global program leadership

  • Architect and steer the end-to-end program model for packaging and print graphics across multiple regions, including AU, CAN, and UK, in close partnership with regional design and production teams. You are the connective tissue ensuring timeline integrity, dependency mapping, and risk visibility, not the sole executor of regional work.

  • Build and maintain strong regional relationships with design, marketing, supply chain, and legal counterparts in each market, trusted enough that people come to you early.

Compliance & regulatory fluency

  • Develop working knowledge of healthcare packaging compliance requirements across regions, and embed compliance checkpoints upstream in the creative process.

  • Translate regulatory requirements into clear creative briefs and review criteria that designers and legal can both work from.

Creative partnership

  • Partner with designers from brief through final production file, understanding creative intent well enough to protect it through the operational and compliance gauntlet.

  • Bring broad fluency across print graphics production, structural packaging, and industrial design/CMF — color management, dielines, press-ready specs, vendor pre-press workflows — enough to translate between disciplines, ask the right questions, and know where things typically break. You're not expected to be the deepest expert in any one domain, but you're the person who can speak all their languages and engage credibly in each conversation.

  • Build the mechanisms — capacity dashboards, resourcing reviews, structured tradeoff conversations — that make the creative team's bandwidth and constraints visible to stakeholders, so capacity conversations happen proactively with leadership rather than reactively with designers.

You Have:

  • 8-10+ years in design program management or creative operations, with meaningful time in healthcare, consumer goods, or a regulated packaging environment.

  • Proven track record building processes from scratch. You've created process infrastructure where little existed, and you're energized by that, not intimidated by it.

  • Broad packaging program expertise. You've owned programs from kickoff to press check and can speak to exactly where things typically go wrong to avoid it.

  • Demonstrated organizational influence. You've shaped how a team or function operates beyond your own programs, without relying on leadership to do it.

  • Experience designing prioritization frameworks that stakeholders actually adopt — not just building Gantt charts, but shifting how an org makes sequencing decisions.

  • Cross-disciplinary fluency in industrial design, structural packaging, and CMF — enough to be a credible partner across the full packaging design ecosystem, without needing to be the deepest expert in any one area.

  • Proficiency with PM tooling (Asana, Airtable, Google Suite, Dropbox) and comfort reviewing work in Figma.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

The Director of Program Management, Global Events will lead the program management function within Kaseya's Global Events organization. This role owns how Kaseya's global event portfolio is planned, governed, resourced, and measured, turning strategy into an integrated, predictable, and scalable operating model across every region and event type.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Global Events, this leader will oversee the end-to-end program management of Kaseya's flagship conferences, regional events, executive experiences, customer and partner programs, sales kickoffs. The role leads a team of event program managers, sets the standards and tools they use, and connects Events with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Leadership, ensuring every program is delivered on time, on budget, and with measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with the VP of Global Events to translate the global event strategy into an integrated annual and multi-year portfolio plan.
  • Own the global events calendar, balancing business priorities, regional needs, budget, and team capacity.
  • Lead event intake, business case review, and prioritization, ensuring every investment is tied to clear objectives such as pipeline, customer retention, and brand.
  • Run portfolio planning and business reviews with senior stakeholders, recommending where to invest, scale, consolidate, or retire programs.

Program Governance & Operating Model

  • Build and lead the Events Program Management team, defining the frameworks, phase gates, and decision rights used to deliver every event.
  • Create standardized playbooks, templates, timelines, RACI models, and run-of-show standards that scale across event types and regions.
  • Establish a consistent planning cadence, including status reporting, risk reviews, and executive checkpoints, that gives leadership clear visibility across the portfolio.
  • Drive continuous improvement through post-event retrospectives, lessons learned, and process optimization.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream programs such as flagship conferences and global sales kickoffs, coordinating content, registration, marketing, sales, production, logistics, and executive involvement.
  • Align stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, and regional teams on scope, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Manage dependencies, critical paths, and scope changes across concurrent programs, escalating and resolving issues quickly.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and tradeoffs.

Budget, Resource & Vendor Management

  • Own consolidated financial management for the global events portfolio, including multimillion-dollar budgeting, multi-currency forecasting, and variance reporting.
  • Lead resource and capacity planning across the program management team, agencies, and freelance partners.
  • Drive global sourcing strategy and lead negotiations with venues, agencies, production partners, and suppliers, using portfolio scale to improve value.
  • Establish vendor performance standards, service levels, and scorecards to ensure exceptional delivery.

Systems, Data & Reporting

  • Own the events technology and tooling roadmap, including project management, registration, event platforms, and their integration with CRM and marketing automation.
  • Define and track portfolio KPIs includes budget adherence, attendee satisfaction, pipeline contribution, revenue influence, and event ROI.
  • Deliver executive dashboards and portfolio reporting with actionable recommendations.
  • Use data and insights to improve planning accuracy, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global team of event program managers.
  • Define roles, career paths, and competency standards for event program management.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and operational discipline.
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and professional development.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in event program management, event operations, or a related program management role, including 5+ years leading teams.
  • 10+ Proven success managing a global portfolio of large-scale conferences, customer and partner events, executive programs, sales kickoffs, and trade shows across multiple regions.
  • 10+ Demonstrated experience building or leading a PMO, or establishing program governance, standardized processes, and scalable operating models.
  • 5+ Experience owning multimillion-dollar budgets, multi-currency forecasting, contract negotiations, and vendor partnerships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Event Management, or a related field.
  • Experience within technology, cybersecurity, IT services, or high-growth organizations.
  • Advanced proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Monday.com, Jira), event management platforms (e.g., Cvent), and CRM and marketing automation systems (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot).
  • Strong knowledge of international event logistics, risk management, and compliance requirements.
  • Exceptional program management skills, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, and risk mitigation across concurrent programs.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, often without direct authority.
  • Experience leading distributed teams in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.jobDescription:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

Engagement Management is a new and fast-growing practice at ClickUp, and it's quickly becoming central to how we serve our enterprise customers. Our EMs bring program leadership, service delivery and change management together in one role. As a ClickUp Senior Engagement Manager you will lead the formation and orchestration of post-sale strategy and execution for the company’s largest and most strategic clients. We're looking for someone hungry, who excels in building, and who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work.

Here, Engagement Managers are the single point of accountability for outcomes. You own everything between the contract being signed and the client seeing measurable results: what was sold gets delivered, on time and on margin, and we can prove it worked.

You'll lead enterprise SaaS implementations across the full engagement lifecycle, from shaping scope in pre-sales, mobilizing the team and delivery, go-live, stabilization and a clean handover to the account team. You'll run work-stream programs with Paid TAMs, AI specialists, Product and Engineering, and the client's own project team, and you'll be the trusted advisor to the client's executive sponsor.

Simply put: you are the single point of accountability for delivery, the client's partner in getting value from ClickUp, and a thought leader for how we deliver.

Your role

  • Stakeholder Management

    • Serve as the primary client contact for delivery

    • Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.

    • Build trusted relationships with client executive sponsors and program leads at VP and C-level, acting as their primary point of contact for delivery.

    • Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder environments and competing priorities across client functions (IT, PMO, business sponsors, procurement) and broker alignment when they conflict.

  • Project Delivery Oversight

    • Deliver engagements against agreed scope, schedule, hours budget and quality, using rigorous change control to protect timelines and delivery margin.

    • Translate customer business requirements into internal deliverables and milestones

    • Own engagement governance, including kickoffs, weekly working sessions, sponsor check-ins and SteerCos, and provide clear, concise status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders.

    • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.

    • Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies through the RAID log, and act as the primary escalation point.

    • Manage engagement financials, including hours burn, forecasting, utilisation and margin, flagging overrun risk early and agreeing recovery plans.

  • Drive AI adoption

    • Guide clients from manual workflows to AI-assisted and agent-driven operations, and own post-go-live adoption outcomes.

  • Drive Value and Business Outcomes

    • Identify expansion opportunities through delivery and co-sell with Account Executives, bringing the delivery credibility that secures follow-on work.

    • Establish a value baseline before configuration begins, track benefits through go-live, and produce the value assessment that underpins renewal and expansion.

  • Governance

    • Design and run governance mechanisms

    • Track delivery efficacy, timelines, value realization and customer experience

    • Create continuous-improvement mechanisms

  • Change Management & Communication

    • Own communications around delivery status, risks and outcomes

    • Manage escalation and communication across customer/internal teams

    • Assess change readiness and resistance across impacted teams; build sponsor and champion networks to carry the rollout.

    • Design the communications and enablement plan with the client, and sequence go-live to match the organization's capacity for change.

  • Role Development

    • Contribute to building the Engagement Management practice by iterating on templates, playbooks and AI workflows that make every engagement faster and more consistent.

Your skills and experience

  • 5+ years of software and/or services delivery experience, with at least 2 years as the accountable project, program or engagement lead.

  • Proven track record taking enterprise SaaS deployments from kickoff through go-live and into adoption, ideally in work management, PSA, CRM, ITSM or collaboration platforms.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS implementation fundamentals: workspace and data architecture, permissions and SSO, integrations, data migration, change management and enablement. No coding required, but you can challenge an unrealistic technical scope.

  • Comfortable with Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery, and knowing which one the client actually needs.

  • Commercial acumen: you've managed engagement budgets, SoWs, change requests and margin, and you know when to push for expansion vs when to stabilize.

  • Executive presence: you can run a SteerCo, deliver bad news early with a recovery plan, and hold a line on scope with a CIO in the room.

  • Experience leading cross-functional and distributed teams you don't directly manage, across client, partner and internal resources.

  • Strategic judgment to separate genuine product gaps from client process or training gaps.

  • Hands-on with AI: you already use AI to work faster, and you can credibly advise clients on where agents and automation fit.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Status reports people actually read.

Nice to have: Experience in work management or SaaS software, professional services firms, agencies or regulated industries. PMP Certification.

What you'll love about working here

  • Impact: Lead high-visibility enterprise engagements with global brands, and see the result in their day-to-day work.

  • Build something: Engagement Management is a new function. You'll help define the methodology, tooling and AI workflows that become the standard.

  • AI at the centre: Work on the frontier of AI-driven work management, with ClickUp Brain and Super Agents in your own delivery toolkit.

  • Career growth: A clear path from Engagement Manager to Senior or Principal Engagement Manager.

  • Community: Learn alongside Paid TAMs, AI specialists and delivery leaders across EMEA and NA.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Fraud Alert

ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com. We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com.

AI Processing Notice

ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes.
